lines.hook: Could you actually afford to live in Chicago?
lines.rent: First, rent. A typical one-bedroom averages around twenty-four fifty-seven a month.
lines.food: Then groceries. A basic food budget for one adult is roughly three hundred eighty-six dollars a month.
lines.eat: Eating out isn't cheap either. A casual meal, about twenty dollars. A cappuccino, around five-fifty.
lines.transit: And getting around? A regular C-T-A thirty-day pass costs about eighty-five dollars.
lines.util: Utilities add roughly one hundred eighty-six dollars, and internet and phone push it even higher.
lines.total: Put the basics together, and a single person could easily spend around thirty-two to thirty-three hundred dollars a month.
lines.payoff: And that's before healthcare, insurance, taxes, or entertainment.
lines.cta: Would you live here for that price? Comment yes or no!
